limits.intentsPerStepRule: phase 21.2: max(intentsPerStep, intentsPerInstanceStep x live behavior instances)

pins.section: ## 9. `BehaviorSpec` lifecycle and the bounded intent API
## 10. Runtime bounds (log/intent rate and per-step caps)

cases.title: an invalid intent fails the instance
cases.durableEffect: none; the last completed render state is retained and only a fresh instance recovers (no rollback)

cases.title: two behavior instances write the same control channel
cases.trigger: behavior-0002 and behavior-0003 both emit control_move in one step
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: the per-step intent cap is exceeded
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a behavior claims the camera entity
cases.trigger: ownedTransforms contains the camera entity id
cases.durableEffect: none; no runtime instance is created

cases.title: a behavior claims a physics-bearing entity
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a behavior claims an entity without its behavior component
cases.trigger: ownedTransforms contains an unrelated entity id
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a behavior step returns a promise
cases.durableEffect: none; the thenable is discarded, never awaited

cases.title: a behavior mutates the object returned by prepare()
cases.durableEffect: none; the frozen preparation object rejects the write and the failure is reported as a module error

cases.title: prepare() throws
cases.durableEffect: none; no instance, no port use, no step

cases.title: instantiate() throws for one entity
cases.trigger: instantiate() throws for the second entity carrying the behavior
cases.durableEffect: none; every already-created instance is disposed exactly once

cases.title: a behavior step throws
cases.durableEffect: none; packet-17 fail-stop, no rollback, safe restart only

cases.title: dispose() is idempotent and runs once per instance
cases.trigger: dispose() called on a failed runtime
cases.durableEffect: dispose is called exactly once per created instance (including the failed one) and is not called again by a second dispose()

cases.title: a source-bearing behavior module is selected without a linked output
cases.trigger: modules contains thirdlight.behavior:behavior-0002 but no output is linked for its outputDigest
cases.durableEffect: none; the runtime never compiles or imports behavior code

cases.title: more than 64 behavior modules
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a declaration update would orphan a stored value of a source-bearing behavior
cases.trigger: publishBehavior{declaration-update} removes the key speed while model-0001 stores it
cases.durableEffect: none; nothing is written and the published source record is untouched

cases.title: a transform write outside the transform phase
cases.trigger: emit({ kind: "transform", ... }) in the intent phase
cases.durableEffect: none

cases.title: a behavior tries to stage a physics move
cases.durableEffect: none; the port is callable only from the controller phase (packet 17 §5)

cases.title: console.* from behavior code is not a diagnostics channel
cases.durableEffect: none on the diagnostics payload; the output goes to the browser devtools console and is explicitly out of contract (behaviors.md §2.2/§10)

cases.title: undo of a source publication
cases.durableEffect: the previous record value is restored and the revision advances; the prepared artifact becomes unreferenced and inert (content-storage.md §4.3)

cases.title: a source-bearing snapshot is played without a prepared artifact
cases.trigger: play with a published source whose derived artifact was deleted and never regenerated
cases.durableEffect: none; the publication and the last good build artifact are untouched

cases.title: play/build of an unacknowledged source digest
cases.trigger: the digest is not in content.behaviorTrust.entries
cases.durableEffect: none

floods.title: 1 000 ctx.log calls in one step from one instance
one ctx.log call per step for 40 steps
20 ctx.log calls per step for 2 steps
4 instances each emitting 4 intents in one step
17 instances each emitting 4 intents in one step (68 > 64, within the scaled cap max(64, 5 x 17) = 85; phase 21.2 — it failed at 64 before)
one instance emitting 6 intents in one step (the closed maximum is 5)
